hypothesis: A fault missing from the catalogue is usually buried, so its scarp is gone but the step it imposes on independent potential-field/AEM layers survives and forces those layers' across-strike gradient vectors to share one strike.
mechanism: per-pixel weighted mean-resultant length of doubled across-strike orientations across six independent layers (RTP, isostatic gravity, AEM depth-to-basement, AEM conductivity, DEM, GNSS shear rate), scored as corroboration C (=sum of ranked top-30% edge weights) times excess orientation coherence E_R over a 19-draw translation null (arm A); arm B is the pre-specified ablation C alone on the identical eligible set.
named_non_fault_mimic: lithologic/stratigraphic contacts and Lake Lahontan strandlines: buried alluvial-fan margins and pluvial shorelines also produce co-located, co-oriented steps in AEM depth, conductivity, gravity and DEM with no fault present

protocol.catalogue_features: detector is label-free; no catalogue feature is used

density_matched_sparse_simulation.design: per fold, a seeded 20% subsample of withheld COMPONENTS is the newly-discovered truth; the other 80% stay excluded from visible and from truth so a prediction beside them is a false positive, as beside an unmapped real fault
density_matched_sparse_simulation.sensitivity_note: reported as a diagnostic only; the locked selection statistic stays the preregistered 0.20 fraction. Tests whether the owner-reported live pattern (fewer dots -> higher score) appears at lower simulated truth densities.
density_matched_sparse_simulation.selection_statistic: mean over the four folds of the sparse-simulated DTI
density_matched_sparse_simulation.limitation: a simulation of the live regime, not the live regime; no organizer label is available
